visual_identity.core_identity: A huge serpentine reptile with many pairs of short powerful legs, a horned predatory head, and a body built to coil.
visual_identity.silhouette: Very long snake-like torso in strong curves, numerous paired legs along the sides, horned head raised from the body.
visual_identity.head_features: Long reptilian head with strong jaws, backward horns or spines, alert eyes, and no wings.
visual_identity.body_shape: Serpentine segmented torso with many pairs of short legs spaced along its length and a tapering tail.
visual_identity.surface: Large simple scales or ridge plates with minimal texture.
